scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node ./scripts/post-build.mjs
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/antyakshari run build && node ./scripts/post-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
